grammar.explain: Romanian combines suffixed articles, gender and number agreement, case forms, verbal tense and mood, object clitics, relatively flexible word order, and prosody. Form choices encode reference, time, stance, focus, and social relationship.
grammar.pattern: topic + inflected predicate + marked arguments + stance
